clips.title: The story
paras: Dragonmaw orcs gather at Angerfang Encampment in the central Wetlands, threatening nearby dwarven settlements. Chieftain Nek'rosh Skullcrusher leads the renegades as they prepare to strike Menethil Harbor.

Dragonmaw warriors hold the marsh around Angerfang Encampment in the central Wetlands. Barricades and watchtowers guard the camp, where warriors, bonewarders, and dark spellcasters loyal to the old ways gather. From these defenses, the clan raids travelers on the roads and menaces nearby dwarven digs, including Whelgar's Excavation Site.
